---
title: "geom_sf()"
format: html
---


```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)
library(sf)
library(hrbrthemes)
library(ggrepel)

theme_set(
  theme_void(base_size = 15) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.title.position = "top",
      legend.key.width = unit(2.4, "lines"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = rel(1)),
      plot.caption = element_text(color = "grey40", hjust = 0),
      plot.caption.position = "plot"
    )
)

```


```{r}
# Boundaries and shapes (GeoJSON)
counties <- read_sf("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_us_counties_2020.geojson")
states <- read_sf("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_us_states_2020.geojson")
provinces <- read_sf("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_canada_provinces_2021.geojson")
plumes <- read_sf("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_hms_smoke_2023_06.geojson")
nbac <- read_sf("https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_nbac_burned_area_2023.geojson")

# Data tables (CSV)
smoke_day <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_smoke_county_day_2023_06.csv",
  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character())
)
smoke_month <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_smoke_county_month_2006_2025.csv",
  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character())
)
ember <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_ember_county_day_2023_06.csv",
  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character())
)
aqs <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_aqs_pm25_2023_06.csv",
  col_types = cols(GEOID = col_character(), site_id = col_character())
)
fires <- read_csv(
  "https://bcdanl.github.io/data/wildfire_firms_canada_2023.csv",
  col_types = cols(acq_time = col_character())
)
```


```{r}
# 0.7 * 90 + 0.3 * 100
weighted.mean(c(90, 100), c(0.7, 0.3))

mean(c(90, 100))
```



```{r}
state_smoke_june7 <- smoke_day |>
  filter(date == as.Date("2023-06-07")) |>
  left_join(
    counties |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      select(GEOID, STUSPS, state_name, region, pop_2020),
    by = "GEOID"
  ) |>
  summarize(
    smoke_pm25 = weighted.mean(smoke_pm25, pop_2020),
    people = sum(pop_2020),
    .by = c(STUSPS, state_name, region)
  ) |> 
  arrange(-smoke_pm25)
```


```{r}
top_state_smoke <- state_smoke_june7 |>
  filter(STUSPS != "DC") |>
  group_by(region) |>
  slice_max(smoke_pm25, n = 5) |>
  ungroup()

national_smoke <- weighted.mean(
  state_smoke_june7$smoke_pm25,
  state_smoke_june7$people
)
```


```{r}
p_state0 <- ggplot(
  top_state_smoke,
  aes(
    x = smoke_pm25,
    y = fct_reorder(state_name, smoke_pm25),
    color = region
  )
)
```


```{r}
p_state0
```

```{r}

p_state0 <- ggplot(
  top_state_smoke,
  aes(
    x = smoke_pm25,
    y = fct_reorder(state_name, smoke_pm25),
    color = region
  )
)

p_state1 <- p_state0 +
  geom_vline(xintercept = national_smoke,
             color = "grey45",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2.4) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  labs(x = "Smoke PM2.5 (µg/m³)", y = NULL,
       color = "Census region")

p_state1
```

```{r}
region_colors <- c(
  Midwest = "#d79a2b", Northeast = "#b2182b",
  South = "#3f78a8", West = "#578b67"
)

p_state2 <- p_state1 +
  scale_color_manual(values = region_colors)
p_state2
```

```{r}
state_lines <- geom_sf(
  data = states, 
  fill = NA,
  # fill = "lightblue",
  color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.25
)

ggplot() + 
  state_lines
```


```{r}

ggplot(counties) +
  geom_sf(fill = "#efe7d8",
          color = "#8b7767",
          linewidth = 0.05) +
  state_lines
```


```{r}
regions <- counties |>
  group_by(region) |>
  summarize(pop = sum(pop_2020))

ggplot(regions) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = region),
          color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = region_colors) +
  geom_sf_label(
    aes(label = paste0(region, "\n",
      number(pop / 1e6, accuracy = 0.1),
      "M")),
    size = 3.2,
    color = "#243b53", fill = "#fffaf0"
  ) +
  guides(fill = "none")
```

```{r}
east_zoom <- coord_sf(
  crs = "ESRI:102009",
  xlim = c(-95, -60), ylim = c(36, 56),
  default_crs = st_crs(4326)
)

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = provinces,
          fill = "#e7d9c4", color = "white") +
  geom_sf(data = states,
          fill = "grey80", color = "white") +
  east_zoom
```

```{r}
june7 <- smoke_day |>
  filter(date == as.Date("2023-06-07"))

smoke_june7 <- counties |>
  left_join(june7, by = "GEOID")

class(smoke_june7)
```


```{r}
smoke_category <- smoke_june7 |>
  mutate(smoke_band = case_when(
                          smoke_pm25 < 15 ~ "<15",
                          smoke_pm25 <= 35 ~ "15–35",
                          TRUE ~ ">35"
                        ) 
    ) |> 
  mutate(smoke_band = factor(smoke_band,
                             levels = c("<15", "15–35", ">35"))
         )

us_albers <- coord_sf(crs = "ESRI:102003")

p_band0 <- ggplot(
  smoke_category,
  aes(fill = smoke_band)
) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) + 
  state_lines +
  scale_fill_brewer(
    palette = "YlOrRd",
    name = "Smoke PM2.5 (µg/m³)"
  ) +
  us_albers +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
p_band0
```

```{r}
q_breaks <- quantile(june7$smoke_pm25,
                     c(0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8))

ggplot(smoke_june7) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = smoke_pm25),
          color = NA) +
  state_lines + us_albers +

    palette = "YlOrRd", direction = 1,
    breaks = q_breaks,
    labels = label_number(0.1),
    name = "Smoke PM2.5 (quintiles)"
  )
```

```{r}
june_diff <- smoke_month |>
  filter(month == 6) |>
  group_by(GEOID) |>
  summarize(diff = smoke_pm25[year == 2023] -
    mean(smoke_pm25[year <= 2022]))

counties |>
  left_join(june_diff, by = "GEOID") |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = diff)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) + 
  state_lines +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    midpoint = 0,
    low = "#2166ac", high = "#b2182b",
    name = "Change vs. usual June (µg/m³)") +
  us_albers
```

```{r}

counties |>
  left_join(june_diff, by = "GEOID") |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = diff)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) + 
  state_lines +
  scale_fill_gradient(
    low = "#2166ac", high = "#b2182b",
    name = "Change vs. usual June (µg/m³)") +
  us_albers
```

```{r}
june23 <- smoke_month |>
  filter(year == 2023, month == 6)

days_map <- counties |>
  left_join(june23, by = "GEOID") |>
  mutate(person_days = days_gt15 * pop_2020)

ggplot(days_map, aes(fill = days_gt15)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) + state_lines +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Days with smoke > 15 µg/m³") +
  us_albers
```

```{r}

ggplot(days_map, aes(fill = person_days)) +
  geom_sf(color = NA) + state_lines +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    name = "Days with smoke > 15 µg/m³") +
  us_albers
```
